name: io.github.flagman5/rankreactor
title: RankReactor
description: Hosted RankReactor MCP: SEO articles, UGC video, keywords, analytics, and site audits.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional when the client uses MCP OAuth (required for ChatGPT custom MCP plugins). For direct-key clients, send the project API key as a Bearer token to https://www.rankreactor.ai/mcp.

api_key.description: Generate in RankReactor Dashboard → API Key. The full value is shown once (rr_live_...). Skip this input for ChatGPT plugins and other OAuth clients.
